financing_evidence: Samsung Finance+ offers financing options for Galaxy devices, including interest-free EMI plans and terms up to 24 months, with online and in-shop flows.
commercial_angle: High-volume smartphone financing program; potential need for portfolio/device management at financed-device scale.
notes: Samsung states Finance+ is available in 85,000+ stores across 800+ cities.

financing_evidence: PayJoy offers phone financing with weekly or monthly fixed payments over 3–12 months and supports purchases through stores and online channels.
commercial_angle: Large device-financing ecosystem; qualify operating markets and partner-store model before outreach.
notes: Current public source verifies financing terms and store/online purchase flow; partner-store scale is not quantified here.

financing_evidence: Mogo Kenya offers smartphone loans, with down payments from 20%, repayment periods up to 12 months, dealer locations, and an application process through phone shops.
commercial_angle: Direct smartphone-financing company with phone-shop dealer network; high-priority prospect.
notes: Mogo's current page states that it financed 100,000 smartphones across 36 Kenyan counties in 2025.

financing_evidence: Lipa Polepole offers device financing with a 40% deposit and 1–6 month weekly or monthly installments; applications are processed at branches.
commercial_angle: Direct retailer financing devices; strong AnCar fit because financing occurs at store level.
notes: Current source lists three Nairobi CBD branches.

financing_evidence: Metro offers Affirm financing on select phones, tablets and watches, available at Metro stores, including four interest-free payments every two weeks.
commercial_angle: Large telecom retail financing channel; qualify independent dealer footprint and whether financed-device controls are managed by retail partners.
notes: Official Metro page confirms financing availability at its stores.

financing_evidence: GCI offers device financing with no down payment, low monthly payments and 0% interest; customers can apply at a nearby store or online.
commercial_angle: Established device-financing telecom; qualify store/dealer operations and financed-device control requirements.
notes: Official GCI financing page confirms in-store and online application flows.

financing_evidence: Insta Phone sells Samsung phones and tablets on credit with weekly payments and an upfront deposit; current listings show weekly repayment plans.
commercial_angle: Direct financed-phone retailer; strong store-level AnCar fit.
notes: Current product listings show Samsung devices with weekly payment and deposit amounts.

financing_evidence: Credlock provides smartphone BNPL through partner merchants and POS agents, typically over 3–6 months, and operates a nationwide network of 2,000+ merchants and agents in Nigeria.
commercial_angle: High-fit device-finance marketplace with a large merchant network; potential channel partnership or merchant-level AnCar opportunity.
notes: Official Credlock pages confirm smartphone BNPL, merchant tooling and 2,000+ merchants/agents.

financing_evidence: Qist Bazaar sells smartphones through installment plans with low down payments and monthly repayment schedules, including current Itel, Samsung, Infinix and Vivo listings.
commercial_angle: Active smartphone BNPL retailer/platform; qualify merchant footprint and financed-device portfolio size.
notes: Current product pages show active installment plans with advance payments and 3–12 month options.

financing_evidence: Watu finances smartphones through authorized partner stores and dealers in Nigeria, requiring a small down payment and supporting repayment through its app.
commercial_angle: High-fit financed-smartphone operator with dealer network and device-control workflow; strong AnCar prospect.
notes: Watu states financing is provided through partner stores/dealers and its app supports payments and device unlock controls.

financing_evidence: EBA Phones offers iPhone installment plans where customers pay 40% upfront and the balance over 3 months, with additional buy-now-pay-later offers up to 12 weeks.
commercial_angle: Direct smartphone retailer with explicit installment financing; strong store-level AnCar fit.
notes: Current public site lists active iPhone buy-now-pay-later products and installment terms.
